quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.description: Blocked transactions held out of journals and reports until missing prices, basis, assets, or pair evidence are fixed.
quarantine.balanceExplanation: Blocked transactions stay out of journals and reports until their evidence is fixed. Quarantine is not a wallet or balance bucket: transactions remain in their source wallet. Observed on-chain balances still include the coins; book-based totals omit unresolved accounting effects and may change after review.
quarantine.empty: No quarantined transactions in the active book.

evidence.price: Add a fiat price or rates coverage
evidence.pair: Choose or dismiss the matching movement
evidence.basis: No acquisition lot is available for this disposal
evidence.asset: Map the source asset before reporting
evidence.splitTransfer: Review the self-transfer and residual swap or payout leg
evidence.coarsePricing: Priced from daily rates — fetch precise prices or confirm
evidence.ownershipAmountMismatch: Recorded {{rowAmount}}, but owned outputs sum to {{ownedOutputs}}
evidence.ownershipTransfer: Proven from the on-chain transaction — an output paid another of your wallets, but the matching receipt couldn't be resolved automatically
evidence.ownedFanout: The transaction pays more than one wallet you own, so each real receipt must be confirmed as its own carrying-value leg
evidence.conflictingSpend: Two transactions spend the same input. Only the confirmed winner belongs in the journal
evidence.pendingConfirmation: The synced chain payload explicitly reports this transaction as unconfirmed
evidence.nativeTransitionFeeTiming: The custody link is proven, but the debit and receipt fall on different UTC dates or their timestamps are unavailable. Kassiber cannot automatically date the fee difference.
evidence.nativeTransitionAmountMismatch: The link between the transactions is proven, but the recorded amounts and fees do not reconcile to a positive transfer.
evidence.nativeTransitionAmbiguous: Native payment evidence matches more than one record. Kassiber needs a unique source before carrying its cost basis.
evidence.ownershipSourceMissing: The receipt spends an output belonging to another connected wallet, but that wallet's outgoing record is missing.
evidence.collaborativeReview: Wallet observations show your inputs and outputs. They do not yet explain which difference is your fee, a payment or another receipt in this shared transaction.

nextAction.basis: Sync or import the funding acquisition, then process journals
nextAction.splitTransfer: Review split transfer/swap, then process journals
nextAction.coarsePricing: Fetch precise prices or confirm, then process journals
nextAction.ownershipTransfer: Pair it manually, or sync the destination wallet so its receipt is recorded, then process journals
nextAction.ownershipConsolidation: Several of your wallets funded this spend — review the consolidation and pair it, then process journals
nextAction.ownershipAmountMismatch: The recorded amount disagrees with the on-chain transaction — re-sync the wallet, then process journals
nextAction.ownedFanout: Confirm each real destination receipt separately, then process journals
nextAction.conflictingSpend: Sync confirmations, verify which transaction won, and exclude a loser only when the chain evidence is clear
nextAction.pendingConfirmation: Wait for confirmation or sync the wallet again, then process journals
nextAction.nativeTransitionFeeTiming: Review supporting records to establish when the fee difference was incurred.
nextAction.nativeTransitionAmountMismatch: Review the source amount and fee treatment against the complete recipient amount using supporting records.
nextAction.nativeTransitionAmbiguous: Check the matching records and their networks. Resolve duplicates or provide evidence identifying the payment.
nextAction.ownershipSourceMissing: Sync the sending wallet or import its missing history, then process journals.
nextAction.collaborativeReview: Review the connected wallet history and supporting records, then record the supported movements and fees in a custody component.

resolvePlan.title: Quarantine resolve plan
resolvePlan.description: A safe sequence for clearing this queue without guessing tax treatment.
resolvePlan.summary: {{count}} quarantined rows · {{steps}} repair steps before journal processing

sync-wallets.title: Sync or check wallet records
sync-wallets.detail: Rows where the recorded amount disagrees with owned on-chain outputs should be synced or inspected before anything else.

review-transfers.title: Review transfer decisions
review-transfers.detail: Transfer, self-transfer, and split-swap rows need a human pairing decision before journals can trust the movement.

fix-basis.title: Review missing cost basis
fix-basis.detail: These rows need acquisition lots or source context before tax reports can include their disposals.

add-prices.title: Add or confirm prices
add-prices.detail: Missing or coarse prices can be resolved in the pricing tab, then saved through the queue.

review-other.title: Review remaining blockers
review-other.detail: These rows need a case-by-case check because they do not fit a safer bulk category.

process.title: Process journals
process.detail: Run this after the repair steps. Anything still unsafe will stay quarantined.

ownershipSourceMissing.title: Sending wallet history is missing
ownershipSourceMissing.why: This receipt spends coins that belong to {{wallets}}, but that wallet's outgoing transaction is not in the book.
ownershipSourceMissing.provide: Sync {{wallets}} (raise its gap limit if it used many addresses) or import its history. Kassiber then books this as a transfer between your wallets.

ownershipSourceAmbiguous.title: Several own wallets could have sent this
ownershipSourceAmbiguous.why: The inputs belong to more than one of your wallets, or their network does not match the transaction.
ownershipSourceAmbiguous.provide: Open the pairing review and choose which wallets funded this transfer.

ownershipDestinationAmbiguous.title: Several receipts match this transfer
ownershipDestinationAmbiguous.why: {{wallet}} has more than one incoming transaction that could be the other side of this transfer.
ownershipDestinationAmbiguous.provide: Open the pairing review and pick the matching receipt.

ownershipDestinationMissingRef.title: Destination wallet is not in this book
ownershipDestinationMissingRef.why: The chain shows the coins went to an address of one of your wallets, but that wallet is not set up in this book.
ownershipDestinationMissingRef.provide: Connect that wallet to this book or check its configuration.

ownershipAmountMismatch.title: Recorded amount does not match the chain
ownershipAmountMismatch.why: The outputs to your own wallets are larger than this row's amount plus fee.
ownershipAmountMismatch.provide: Sync the sending wallet again so its amount comes from the chain.

ownershipConservation.title: The amounts of this transfer do not add up
ownershipConservation.why: Inputs, outputs and fee of this transfer between your wallets cannot be balanced.
ownershipConservation.provide: Sync the involved wallets again; if the amounts stay inconsistent, check the imported file.

ownershipFeeEvidence.title: The network fee cannot be proven
ownershipFeeEvidence.why: The row includes a fee, but the values of the spent inputs are unknown, so the exact fee cannot be separated.
ownershipFeeEvidence.provide: Sync the wallet through a backend that returns input values (Electrum, Esplora or your own node).

ownershipAssetEvidence.title: Output amounts are hidden or incomplete
ownershipAssetEvidence.why: An output to your wallet has no readable amount or asset (for example confidential Liquid amounts).
ownershipAssetEvidence.provide: Sync the receiving wallet with its descriptor so Kassiber can read the amounts.

ownershipAmbiguousOutput.title: One address belongs to two wallets
ownershipAmbiguousOutput.why: The same script is watched by more than one of your wallets, so it is unclear which one received it.
ownershipAmbiguousOutput.provide: Remove the duplicate descriptor or address from one of the wallets.

ownershipDuplicateOutbound.title: The same payment was recorded twice
ownershipDuplicateOutbound.why: Several outgoing rows describe the same transaction, usually after importing the same history twice.
ownershipDuplicateOutbound.provide: Delete or exclude the duplicate import and keep the row that came from the chain.

liquidGraphIncomplete.title: Liquid transfer is incomplete
liquidGraphIncomplete.why: Kassiber found only part of this Liquid transfer's receipts in your wallets.
liquidGraphIncomplete.provide: Sync all involved Liquid wallets or connect the wallet that received the rest.

recordedAuthorityConflict.title: One side comes from a file, the other from the chain
recordedAuthorityConflict.why: Only one side of this transfer is confirmed by a chain sync; the other side is an imported record.
recordedAuthorityConflict.provide: Sync the wallet whose side came from a file so both sides are observed on chain.

chronologyMismatch.title: Transfer arrives before it leaves
chronologyMismatch.why: The receiving side is dated earlier than the sending side by more than the allowed clock difference.
chronologyMismatch.provide: Check the timestamps of the imported rows (time zone) or pair the correct transactions.

networkMismatch.title: Transfer crosses networks
networkMismatch.why: The two sides of this pair are on different networks or units.
networkMismatch.provide: Remove the pairing, or record the movement as a swap in the pairing review.

feeImplausible.title: Too much is missing in this transfer
feeImplausible.why: More than 1 % (at least 2,500 sats) of this transfer is explained neither by the receipt nor by the fee.
feeImplausible.provide: If part went to another wallet of yours, connect it; otherwise pair the correct receipt or record the difference.

privacyHop.title: CoinJoin or shared transaction needs evidence
privacyHop.why: This row is part of a shared transaction. The chain does not show which part was yours, a payment or a fee.
privacyHop.provide: Connect all involved wallets (for example pre-mix and post-mix), or attach the wallet's records and describe the movement.

samouraiUnverified.title: Samourai/Whirlpool step not confirmed on chain
samouraiUnverified.why: This Samourai step comes from an export and was not confirmed by a sync of all involved wallets.
samouraiUnverified.provide: Sync the Deposit, Premix and Postmix wallets.

channelOpen.title: Lightning channel opening is not explained
channelOpen.why: The on-chain funding is larger than what the node reports as funded into the channel.
channelOpen.provide: Import the Lightning node's history or connect the wallet that received the change.

channelClose.title: Lightning channel closing is not explained
channelClose.why: The funds returned when the channel closed do not match the channel balance within the fee tolerance.
channelClose.provide: Import the node's history or connect the wallet that received the closing output.

nativeTransitionAmbiguous.title: Several payments match this swap
nativeTransitionAmbiguous.why: The payment hash of this Lightning swap matches more than one record.
nativeTransitionAmbiguous.provide: Open the pairing review and choose the matching payment.

nativeTransitionAmountMismatch.title: Swap amounts do not balance
nativeTransitionAmountMismatch.why: The proven swap route does not keep the amounts on both sides equal.
nativeTransitionAmountMismatch.provide: Attach the swap provider's record and review the swap.

nativeTransitionFeeTiming.title: Swap fee falls on a different day
nativeTransitionFeeTiming.why: The swap is proven, but part of its fee occurred on a later day. Kassiber cannot book separately dated fees yet.
nativeTransitionFeeTiming.provide: No input resolves this automatically yet; it stays visible until Kassiber supports it.

migrationIncomplete.title: An older review could not be carried over
migrationIncomplete.why: A transfer pair or payout reviewed in an older version could not be converted to the current format.
migrationIncomplete.provide: Open the transaction and review the pairing again.

gapHold.title: An intermediate wallet is missing
gapHold.why: Coins left {{wallet}} and a similar amount came back later, but the wallet in between is not connected.
gapHold.provide: Connect the wallet the coins went through (its xpub or descriptor). If you no longer have it, confirm the route in the custody-gap review.

implicitDelta.title: Wallet balance changed without a recorded transaction
implicitDelta.why: The observed balance of {{wallet}} differs from its recorded transactions.
implicitDelta.provide: Sync the wallet again or import its complete history.

unclaimedResidual.title: Part of this outflow is unexplained
unclaimedResidual.why: Part of this outflow went neither to a known wallet of yours nor to a recorded recipient.
unclaimedResidual.provide: Connect the wallet that received the rest, or record where it went.

sourceOverlap.title: Two sources record the same coins
sourceOverlap.why: Two connected sources (for example an address list and a descriptor) both claim these coins.
sourceOverlap.provide: Remove the overlapping source or keep only one of them.

searchCapacity.title: Too many candidates to check automatically
searchCapacity.why: Kassiber stopped searching for a missing wallet here because there were too many possibilities.
searchCapacity.provide: Review this custody gap manually or with the assistant.

componentProblem.title: A reviewed custody route no longer matches
componentProblem.why: A custody route you reviewed earlier no longer matches the current transactions (for example after a new sync).
componentProblem.provide: Review the custody component and create a new revision.

reviewedSuspense.title: A reviewed route keeps part in suspense
reviewedSuspense.why: Part of a reviewed custody route is deliberately held in suspense, so later cost basis is not final.
reviewedSuspense.provide: Resolve the suspended part: connect the wallet it went to or record what happened to it.

quantityOther.title: Custody of these coins is unresolved
quantityOther.why: Kassiber cannot tell where part of these coins is held.
quantityOther.provide: Open the transaction; connecting the missing wallet or reviewing the route resolves it.

basisBarrier.title: Waiting for an earlier problem
basisBarrier.why: An earlier transaction in this holding is unresolved ({{root}}), so the cost basis from that point on is not final.
basisBarrier.provide: Nothing to do here: this clears automatically once the earlier transaction is resolved.

pairDependency.title: Part of a blocked transfer chain
pairDependency.why: This row is linked by a transfer to a transaction that is on hold ({{root}}).
pairDependency.provide: Resolve the linked transaction; this row follows automatically.

provenanceIncomplete.title: An earlier lot is unresolved
provenanceIncomplete.why: An earlier {{asset}} transaction ({{since}}) is not booked, so the lots this disposal would use are uncertain.
provenanceIncomplete.provide: Resolve the earlier transaction; this row follows automatically.

groupBlocked.title: Another part of this transfer group is on hold
groupBlocked.why: Another leg of this transfer group is held back; the group is booked all or nothing.
groupBlocked.provide: Resolve the other leg; this row follows automatically.

carryUnresolved.title: Carried cost basis is not available
carryUnresolved.why: This swap carries over the cost basis of the other side, which is not booked yet.
carryUnresolved.provide: Resolve the other side of the swap; this row follows automatically.

missingPrice.title: Price missing
missingPrice.why: There is no {{asset}} price for this date, so the value in your book currency is unknown.
missingPrice.provide: Refresh market prices or enter the price from your receipt.

pricingReview.title: Only an approximate price is available
pricingReview.why: The price for this date comes from a coarse source (for example a daily average) and your settings require a review.
pricingReview.provide: Confirm the price or enter the exact price from your receipt.

swapPriceRequired.title: Swap payout needs a value
swapPriceRequired.why: The payout of this swap has no amount or value, which the Austrian swap rules need.
swapPriceRequired.provide: Enter the value of the payout.

insufficientLots.title: More spent than ever received
insufficientLots.why: {{wallet}} sends {{required}}, but Kassiber only knows {{available}} of earlier receipts.
insufficientLots.provide: Import the missing purchase history (for example an exchange export) or connect the wallet these coins came from.

missingCostBasis.title: Earlier purchases have no cost basis
missingCostBasis.why: The coins exist, but the purchases they come from have no price, so their cost basis is unknown.
missingCostBasis.provide: Enter the prices of the earlier purchases or import their history with prices.

unclassifiedIncome.title: This kind of income is not supported
unclassifiedIncome.why: This receipt is marked as a kind of income Kassiber cannot map to a tax category.
unclassifiedIncome.provide: Classify it as purchase, income, mining or another supported kind.

nonSaleDisposal.title: Gift, donation or loss needs a decision
nonSaleDisposal.why: This outflow is marked as a gift, donation, loss or theft. Kassiber does not guess its tax treatment.
nonSaleDisposal.provide: Decide the treatment: reclassify it, exclude it or set its tax category.

valuationUnsupported.title: Airdrop or hard fork valuation is not supported
valuationUnsupported.why: Kassiber does not value airdrops or hard forks for Austrian tax.
valuationUnsupported.provide: Classify the receipt differently if it is not an airdrop, or keep it excluded.

conflictingSpend.title: Replaced or double-spent transaction
conflictingSpend.why: Another transaction spends the same coins. Only the one that confirms counts.
conflictingSpend.provide: Wait for the confirmation and sync again; the replaced transaction then drops out.

pendingConfirmation.title: Not confirmed yet
pendingConfirmation.why: This transaction is still in the mempool.
pendingConfirmation.provide: Nothing to do: it is booked once it confirms and the wallet syncs.

unscopedTransfer.title: Transfer without a chain reference
unscopedTransfer.why: Two rows in different wallets of yours share a provider ID but have no transaction graph, so Kassiber cannot prove they are one transfer.
unscopedTransfer.provide: Pair them in the pairing review, or sync the wallets from the chain.

ownedFanout.title: Payment to several own wallets does not add up
ownedFanout.why: This transaction sends to several of your wallets, but the recorded receipts do not match the amounts.
ownedFanout.provide: Sync or connect every receiving wallet, or pair the receipts in the pairing review.

pairAmbiguous.title: The pairing is ambiguous
pairAmbiguous.why: The paired transactions do not form one consistent transfer.
pairAmbiguous.provide: Open the pairing review and correct the pairing.

missing_wallet_history.title: Wallet history is missing
missing_wallet_history.why: Part of this movement happened in a wallet whose history is not in the book.
missing_wallet_history.provide: Connect or sync the missing wallet.

missing_chain_evidence.title: Chain evidence is incomplete
missing_chain_evidence.why: The data Kassiber has for this transaction is not complete enough to prove its amounts.
missing_chain_evidence.provide: Sync the wallet again from the chain.

missing_price.title: Price missing
missing_price.why: The value of this transaction in your book currency is unknown.
missing_price.provide: Refresh market prices or enter the price.

missing_acquisition_history.title: Acquisition history is missing
missing_acquisition_history.why: Kassiber does not know where these coins were acquired or at what cost.
missing_acquisition_history.provide: Import the purchase history or connect the wallet the coins came from.

needs_decision.title: Needs your decision
needs_decision.why: The evidence allows more than one reading.
needs_decision.provide: Open the transaction and decide how it should be booked.

unsupported.title: Not supported yet
unsupported.why: Kassiber cannot book this kind of transaction yet.
unsupported.provide: It stays visible until support is added.

downstream.title: Waiting for another transaction
downstream.why: This row depends on another transaction that is unresolved.
downstream.provide: Resolve the other transaction; this row follows automatically.

panel.title: Why is something in quarantine?
panel.intro: Kassiber holds a transaction back from the tax journals when the evidence is not enough to book it correctly. It never guesses a taxable event. Each cause below says what is missing and what you can provide.
panel.reportsBlocked: Tax and portfolio reports stay blocked until the causes marked “Blocks reports” are resolved.
panel.causesHint: Resolving an earlier cause often clears later rows, so work from the top.
panel.moreCauses_one: {{count}} more cause is listed in the table below.
panel.moreCauses_other: {{count}} more causes are listed in the table below.
panel.dependents_one: {{count}} dependent transaction clears automatically once this is resolved.
panel.dependents_other: {{count}} dependent transactions clear automatically once this is resolved.
panel.deprecatedWallet: {{wallet}} is marked deprecated, so “Refresh all” skips it; sync it on its own.
panel.gapReviewLocked: Custody-gap review is currently part of the developer tools. Connect the missing wallet or ask the assistant to investigate.
panel.syncStartedBody: Kassiber syncs the wallet and then recalculates the quarantine.

freshness.staleBody: Transactions changed after journals were last processed ({{when}}). Recalculate to see the current quarantine.
freshness.neverBody: Journals have not been processed yet. Recalculate to see which transactions need attention.
freshness.failedBody: {{message}} The list shows the state before that attempt.

assumptions.title: Assumptions Kassiber made
assumptions.intro: These transactions are not in quarantine, but they change your results if the assumption is wrong.
assumptions.outboundWhy: No wallet of yours received these coins, so Kassiber treats them as sold or spent at market value.
assumptions.outboundFix: If some went to your own wallet, connect that wallet: they become transfers without tax effect. Classify real payments to confirm them.
assumptions.inboundTitle_one: {{count}} receipt of unknown origin booked as a purchase
assumptions.inboundTitle_other: {{count}} receipts of unknown origin booked as purchases
assumptions.inboundWhy: These receipts have no recorded origin, so Kassiber books them as purchases at market value on the day received.
assumptions.inboundFix: If they came from an older wallet of yours, connect it so the original cost basis and holding period are kept. If they are income, classify them.

explanation.title: Capital-gains calculation
explanation.description: Exact contributions retained from the tax engine, with source evidence from this journal version.
explanation.unavailable: Engine detail is unavailable for this journal. Rebuild journals to retain the calculation.
explanation.mismatch: Stored calculation detail does not reconcile. Rebuild journals before relying on this result.
explanation.quarantines: {{count}} quarantined transactions are excluded from this journal; this explains only the displayed result.
explanation.inheritedContext: The reviewed carry links this acquisition to the complete outgoing engine calculation below, including its fees. These historical contributions are not an allocation to the later sale.
explanation.inheritedUnavailable: The inherited source calculation is unavailable in this journal. No historical allocation has been inferred.
explanation.inheritedTruncated: The bounded inherited-source trace stops here; further historical calculation detail is not shown.
explanation.poolNote: An engine unit-basis override is the basis used for this calculation. For pooled methods, the selected acquisition is a matching anchor, not an allocation of the pool to that transaction.
explanation.noCustody: No stored custody decisions were found in this source period and wallet context.
explanation.custodyContext: Stored incoming custody moves before this result, back to the earliest engine source. This wallet context does not assign physical coins to tax lots.
explanation.custodyTruncated: More custody decisions exist. Open custody lineage for the complete history.
